name: Ethiopia
_verify: Checked on 13 Nov 2026 against published summaries of VAT Proclamation No. 1341/2024 and Income Tax (Amendment) Proclamation No. 1395/2025. A licensed tax adviser must confirm every rate, threshold and effective date against the official text before go-live. effective_from 1900-01-01 means 'in force before the company's first period'.

einvoicing.system: Electronic Invoice Registration System (Ministry of Revenue)
einvoicing.model: Clearance: each invoice is registered in real time before it is issued and receives an Invoice Registration Number (IRN) and QR code; receipts receive a Receipt Registration Number (RRN).
einvoicing.legal_basis: Electronic Invoicing System Administration Directive No. 1142/2026
einvoicing.status: Directive in force; the Ministry's implementation schedule (Article 29) and technical specification are not yet published. Software must be authorised by the Ministry. Invoices stay queued until Evenbooks is authorised.

fiscal_year.note: The government budget and tax year runs Hamle 1 to Sene 30 (8 July to 7 July; 7 July to 6 July around an Ethiopian leap year). A company on the Ethiopian calendar starts its year in Hamle (month 11); one on the Gregorian calendar usually starts 1 July or 1 January.

legal_basis: Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016 as amended by Proclamation No. 1395/2025 (turnover tax repealed; domestic withholding 3%)
Electronic Invoicing System Administration Directive No. 1142/2026

withholding.note: Withhold when one payment is above the threshold; 30% when the supplier has no TIN.

rules.cash_payment_limit_note: Payments above ETB 50,000 must go through a bank or an authorised electronic channel; Evenbooks warns when a cash payment is above the limit.
rules.books_required_note: Category A taxpayers (annual turnover above ETB 2,000,000), VAT-registered businesses and professional service providers must keep books of account.

vat.note: VAT return and payment within 30 days after the end of each month (VAT Proclamation No. 1341/2024). To be confirmed by the tax adviser.

withholding.note: Tax withheld is paid to the authority within 30 days after the end of the month it was withheld in (Income Tax Proclamation No. 979/2016, as amended). To be confirmed by the tax adviser.
